grounding_followup.bug: Fixed-angle analytic tyre contact missed a rotating tread on a narrow raised road detail; local-axis iterative correction also oscillated on slopes
grounding_followup.fix: Cache actual wheel-local tread vertices, evaluate their current rotation and use one world-vertical suspension correction per wheel
grounding_followup.independent_review: 189 turned, reverse, sloped and mirrored geometry cases; no remaining bounded correctness or performance findings
grounding_followup.phone_startup: Two attempts timed out during scene startup while another district scene was open. Six phone checks passed with only one scene open and the same timeouts; concurrent-scene startup remains a performance limitation.
